name: aurum-jewelry-platform
description: Full-stack jewelry e-commerce platform: storefront, admin dashboard and REST API

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,shop,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
